Torch.description: A simple oil-soaked torch used to illuminate dark passages and reveal what the Underdark would rather keep hidden.

Smoke Bomb.description: A small ceramic charge that erupts into a cloud of thick smoke, reducing incoming damage by 30% during combat.

Lockpick.description: A thin metal tool used to open locked chests, doors, and other mechanisms without their original key.

Rope.description: A sturdy length of rope useful for reaching high ledges, descending into pits, and crossing dangerous terrain.
